title: Extreme heat
tldr: Move to air conditioning or a designated cooling space, reduce exertion and drink water regularly unless your clinician restricts fluids. Confusion, collapse or seizures in heat can mean heat stroke: call emergency services and start rapid cooling.
steps: Use air conditioning, a public cooling center or another safe indoor location.
Rest, loosen unnecessary clothing and use cool wet cloths or a cool shower.
Older adults, infants, outdoor workers and people with illness may need help. Never leave anyone or pets in a parked vehicle.
For altered mental status or collapse, call emergency services and cool the person while waiting; do not give drinks to someone unable to swallow.
next: Plan activities for cooler hours and follow heat alerts. Arrange safe transport before the home becomes dangerously hot.
watch: Heat stroke can occur with sweating. Do not wait for dry skin.
